I take my cats into my backyard so they can enjoy the outdoors. Eventually they started jumping the fence so I did research on what I could do to detour this behavior. I found purrfect fence but I do not have purrfect fence money. I found these on Vevor and gave them a shot! I added deer fencing rather than barbed wire. So far it is working like a dream!! I was worried about them staying in place but the rubber inside the clasp is the key!! Vevor helped me save a tonne of money and my cats can spend more time watching the birds and being teased by the squirrels.

Our 2 year old rescue dog decided one day (after having her ‹NAMN› almost 2 years) that she could *climb* our 5 foot chain link fence in the back yard. She was a Houdini and we had no clue how she was escaping until we put a camera back there and saw she literally climbed the fence like she would climb the stairs. We looked at so many options ‹NAMN› fixing this issue and were just shy of replacing the whole fence with taller wire (which I'm sure she would climb over too) when I found these. We spaced them out about every 5-6 feet and zip tied some chicken wire to the top. So far our little miss houdini has not even attempted to try to escape and has decided the occasional time spent in the back yard with a kiddie pool isn't so bad. Glad she doesn't meet me at the front door anymore. These are great and saved us so much time and money!
